quarterly_data.signal: Mistral released Timestral, its first family of time-series foundation models (probabilistic, multivariate forecasts with past-only and known-future covariates), in four sizes from 5M to 209M parameters; Mistral says the largest, at 209M parameters, ranks first on the three main public benchmarks (GIFT-Eval, TIME, fev-bench), outperforming the previous state of the art with two-thirds of its parameters (company claim; results submitted to the GIFT-Eval and TIME leaderboards).
